All acceptance criteria are already satisfied by commit 5d82c7c8
("fix(routing): resolve haiku alias to ExactPinOnly in eligibility lookup [fizeau-0aa53d01]"),
which was produced by the first execution of this bead.

     selects claude/sonnet-4.6, not haiku; haiku appears in candidates with
     FilterReasonExactPinOnly.

AC2: TestHaikuAliasEligibilityLookupReturnsExactPinOnly passes — ModelEligibility
     lookup for "haiku", "haiku-5.5", and "claude-haiku-5.5" all return
     ExactPinOnly=true.

AC3: go test ./internal/routing/... ./internal/modelcatalog/... -count=1 green
     (no failures in those packages).

AC4: No staged changes; working tree is clean — lefthook pre-commit not applicable.

The service-layer fix (serviceRoutingModelEligibility + addShortAlias in
service_routing.go) and the service-layer test
(service_haiku_alias_eligibility_test.go) are also in place and pass.

Note: the root package "." has pre-existing test failures unrelated to this bead
(timing-sensitive local-health tests, a codex model ID mismatch, a ListModels
network-dependent test). The verification command above scopes to the bead's
specific tests with -run to avoid false failures from those pre-existing issues.
No further code changes are needed for this bead.
